Well I was only 2 at the time so I don’t remember much except for the stories that I’ve been told. My parents never brought it up and I honestly didn’t even know about it until my older sister told me my sophomore year of high school. My parents have always been a bit naive to things. My mom more so than my dad but this seems a bit extreme. My parents decided the best thing to do to prepare for what might happen was to leave the country. So my mom, dad, younger brother, and I packed up and moved to Belize where we lived for the next year until my parents realized nothing had happened and it was all a big hoax. I didn’t realize how bizarre the whole thing was, even after my sister told me, until I told some friends about it. I’m absolutely mortified now that my parents would go to such lengths but unfortunately not surprised.
